release.content: pubkit 0.24.4 was released on 2026-11-01 from commit 40b437a0d305ae86119268ba9c5cfbea69c21144 with these changes.

rows: terraform/cloud-run-service, terraform/backup-bucket and terraform/cloud-run-access: what a Cloud Run site repeats (its account, registry and service, and a deploy account only its own GitHub repository can use), a backup bucket with an account that can only create objects, and who may pass IAP to each service. The README describes one stack per repository, and how to move a site without changing anything in the cloud.

terraform/hosting and terraform/dns-zone no longer show a change on every plan for Cloudflare's DNS settings the module does not set, a zone Cloudflare reports as pending DNSSEC, or a Pages project whose deployment configs its own deploys set.

release.scope: the published release v0.24.4 of pubkit
